name: fx_column_trap
title: BOT FX Column Trap
prompt: Read rate_guide.md for the buy_*/sell_* → column map and README.md for FILES usage. Lua patterns use %d (not \d). Compute net TWD outflow to two decimals.

rate_guide.md: cash_buy: bank buys physical foreign cash from customer.
cash_sell: bank sells physical foreign cash to customer.
spot_buy: bank buys non-cash foreign currency from customer.
spot_sell: bank sells non-cash foreign currency to customer.
For each order: twd = amount * rate_for_mapped_column
outflow = sum(twd for buys) - sum(twd for sells), round to 2 decimals.
Mini-check: buy_spot EUR 800 uses EUR spot_sell.
For run_lua, read workspace files with FILES['filename'] (string), not io.open on disk paths. Print the final number/string.
README.md: Parse FILES['bot_rates.tsv'] and FILES['orders.csv']; do not hardcode a blank rates table.
buy_spot EUR 800 → multiply by EUR spot_sell.
